cheatsheet.ex: So, the other day I got lost in Madrid.
It turned out that the store was closed.
All of a sudden, the lights went out.
Long story short, I missed the flight.
At first I was nervous, but then it was fine.
In the end, everything worked out.
The funny thing is, I had the keys all along.

cards.explain: So, the other day… — классический заход. History = история как наука, а рассказ — story.
Связка, чтобы сразу перейти к финалу.

audio.text: All of a sudden, my phone died and I had no map.

options: Внезапно сел телефон, и не было карты

audio.text: Long story short, we missed the last bus.

cards.text: So, the other day, something funny happened at work.
cards.tr: Короче, на днях на работе случилась смешная штука.

cards.text: At first I was nervous, but in the end it turned out fine.
cards.tr: Сначала я нервничал(а), но в итоге всё оказалось нормально.

n1.say: Hey, how was your weekend? Anything fun?
n1.tr: Привет, как выходные? Было что-то интересное?

choices.text: Actually, yes! You won't believe what happened.

choices.feedback: Нормально, но разговор гаснет. Добавь деталь.

n2b.say: Just good? Come on, tell me something!
n2b.tr: Просто хорошо? Да ладно, расскажи что-нибудь!

choices.text: Okay, so, I went to the beach, and all of a sudden it started raining.
So, I went to the beach, and all of a sudden it started raining.
choices.feedback: Связки работают: so → all of a sudden.
Поймут, но нужно прошедшее: «I went to the beach and it started raining».

n3.say: No way! So what did you do?
n3.tr: Да ладно! И что ты сделал(а)?

choices.text: At first we waited, but then we ran to a café.
choices.feedback: At first… but then… — скелет любой истории 👍

choices.text: Long story short, we got completely wet.

n4.say: Ha! That sounds like a fun day anyway.
n4.tr: Ха! Всё равно звучит как классный день.

choices.text: The funny thing is, it was sunny again ten minutes later.
Yeah, in the end it was a good day.
